settings.title: Three parts, one idea: legacy begins with the person who leads.

settings.editor: Legacy in Action follows the order a family business has to follow: the leader first, then the family, then the enterprise.
Build self-awareness and inner mastery as the foundation.
Personal stewardship comes first: the mindset and discipline a leader needs before leading anyone else.
Strengthen family unity, communication and shared purpose.
Avoid the misunderstandings that damage both the family and the business, and find peace and clarity through proactive succession planning.
Build a resilient business and create a lasting impact.
Create the systems and structures that let a family business last for generations.

settings.title: The must-have guide for every family business.

settings.editor: A practical and heartfelt guide for family business owners who want to preserve unity, strengthen governance and prepare the next generation for responsible leadership. Legacy is not only wealth or business success. It is values, relationships, stewardship, and the deliberate decisions a family makes today.

Jonathan “Jon” Ramos, ACFWA, FFI Fellow
